occupation_family: Information and Communications Technology Services Managers
text: Directs enterprise technology infrastructure strategy across Malaysian hybrid-cloud data centres. Oversees API integration standards, steers data privacy PDPA compliance audits, governs AI ethics and enterprise risk management, and leads cross-functional stakeholder communication with executive leadership.

Programs autonomous guided mobile robots and automated sorting cells in Penang industrial free zones. Writes Python scripting algorithms for sensor fusion, designs industrial workflow automation routines, maps manufacturing operations to standard operating procedures, and performs human-in-the-loop QA on automated visual inspection outputs.

Analyzes semiconductor wafer sort yield datasets using SQL data analysis, develops automated test program sequences using Python scripting, visualizes parametric failure distributions on interactive dashboards, and enforces cleanroom workflow automation across automated test equipment.

source: MASCO 2020 Unit Group 2166 & MDEC Creative Standard
text: Designs human-centred conversational user interfaces and generative user workflows for Malaysian digital consumer applications. Audits corporate general ledgers and transaction journals for statutory regulatory compliance. Executes complex SQL data analysis to detect abnormal financial postings, visualizes audit evidence on dynamic analytical dashboards, and communicates findings through structured stakeholder communication to statutory audit committees.

source: MASCO 2020 Unit Group 2413 & Bursa Malaysia Framework
text: Evaluates equity portfolios against Bursa Malaysia ESG reporting standards and carbon footprint analytics guidelines. Writes modular Python scripting routines to calculate Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions exposure, compiles formal ESG sustainability reporting disclosures, and queries corporate financial databases using SQL data analysis.

source: MASCO 2020 Unit Group 2431 & MDEC Digital Marketing
text: Plans, configures, and monitors omnichannel automated digital marketing funnels across Southeast Asian e-commerce channels. Implements workflow automation rules, integrates customer data platform webhooks via API integration, tracks conversion funnels on data visualization dashboards, and formulates prompt engineering templates for ad copy generation.

Develops public corporate relations strategies and community outreach initiatives for listed Malaysian public companies. Drafts sustainability disclosures and stakeholder communication briefings, synthesizes ESG sustainability reporting achievements, and presents analytical progress using data visualization.

Maintains continuous deployment and container orchestration environments for cloud-native microservices. Automates infrastructure provisioning using Python scripting, implements CI/CD workflow automation pipelines, configures secure API integration gateways, and enforces data privacy PDPA access controls.

Designs high-availability enterprise SD-WAN topologies and network security architectures. Oversees secure API integration endpoints, maps network topology operational workflows using process mapping, analyzes packet telemetries using SQL data analysis, and ensures regulatory compliance with personal data privacy PDPA standards.

occupation_family: Database and Network Professionals Not Elsewhere Classified
text: Monitors security operation centre alerts and investigates potential cyber intrusion incidents. Implements threat mitigation workflow automation, writes Python scripting incident parsing scripts, governs data privacy PDPA breach protocols, and conducts human-in-the-loop QA on AI-generated anomaly detection flags.

Provides psychological counselling and occupational transition support for employees navigating technology-driven business changes. Delivers empathetic stakeholder communication, applies instructional design principles to deliver coping workshops, and adheres to strict client confidentiality and data privacy PDPA standards.

source: MASCO 2020 Unit Group 2642 & MDEC Content Standard
text: Researches, writes, and publishes technical system documentation, software developer user manuals, and API integration guides. Applies structured prompt engineering to accelerate initial draft synthesis, fact-checks generative summaries through human-in-the-loop QA, and communicates key takeaways through stakeholder communication.

occupation_family: Physical and Engineering Science Technicians Not Elsewhere Classified
text: Calibrates, tests, and deploys Internet-of-Things vibration, temperature, and environmental telemetry sensors on factory equipment. Presents technical software demonstrations and negotiates commercial contracts with Malaysian corporate clients. Maps client operational requirements to enterprise process mapping flows, presents cost-benefit comparisons using data visualization dashboards, and manages executive stakeholder communication throughout complex sales cycles.

occupation_family: Business Services Agents Not Elsewhere Classified
text: Evaluates commercial supplier tenders and tracks vendor performance milestones. Queries vendor databases using SQL data analysis, maps procurement workflows using process mapping, verifies supplier compliance with data privacy PDPA rules, and synthesizes key metrics on data visualization summary charts.

Schedules freight dispatch runs and updates consignment airway bills in Port Klang warehouse offices. Follows standard operating procedure process mapping, monitors parcel tracking telemetries, and coordinates transport operations through routine stakeholder communication with truck fleet drivers.

Performs manual document photocopying, physical paper ledger filing, and batch paper scanning in municipal office basements. Organizes paper files into filing boxes, checks duplicate receipts, and follows basic office protocol process mapping without computer programming or statistical analytics.

Adheres to company process mapping guidelines, handles basic stakeholder communication with employees regarding leave balance questions, and maintains employee records under data privacy PDPA confidentiality requirements.

Advises oil palm estates and agricultural smallholders on precision crop management. Visualizes satellite vegetative indices using data visualization, executes SQL data analysis on soil nitrogen and yield logs, and designs carbon footprint analytics models for sustainable agricultural certification.

Designs precision tooling fixtures and automated CNC machining operations in Shah Alam manufacturing facilities. Automates equipment inspection sequences using Python scripting, designs robotic cell workflow automation routines, and maps manufacturing steps using process mapping.

Prepares Scope 1 and 2 carbon footprint analytics audits, compiles statutory ESG sustainability reporting submissions, and maps operational chemical safety procedures using process mapping.

Analyzes workforce competency gaps and designs corporate digital upskilling pathways. Applies instructional design frameworks to author employee learning modules, analyzes candidate recruitment pipelines using SQL data analysis, and leads stakeholder communication with corporate business unit heads.

Engineers scalable, high-traffic web applications and mobile digital banking interfaces. Develops backend microservices using Python scripting, integrates external payment gateways via API integration, implements automated testing workflow automation, and protects confidential customer data under data privacy PDPA rules.

Writes optimized low-level firmware and embedded neural inference code for edge hardware devices. Implements edge runtime integration using Python scripting, integrates hardware telemetry endpoints via API integration, and evaluates quantised inference accuracy through human-in-the-loop QA.
